intersection.headline: Adidas takes AC Milan kit back from Puma in 10-year, $56m-a-season deal
intersection.summary: AC Milan will return to Adidas from summer 2028 in a deal worth about $56m a season, one of the most lucrative kit agreements in Italian football. Milan's last Puma deal was worth roughly $33.6m a season. Adidas supplied the club for 20 years from 1998 to 2018. The news comes in the same week as reports that Adidas will also take the Serie A match ball from Puma from 2027-28.

sports.headline: Fenway Sports Group named as suitor as Mark Walter shops Cadillac F1 stake at $3bn+ valuation
sports.summary: Mark Walter's TWG Global is reportedly exploring a sale of its controlling stake in the Cadillac F1 team at a valuation of at least $3bn, after earlier denials. The Wall Street Journal says Liverpool and Red Sox owner Fenway Sports Group is one of several suitors. The Guardian reports FSG has discussed a majority stake worth more than £2bn. TWG says no sale is imminent.

sports.headline: ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2026 sets records with 471 million viewing hours
sports.summary: The ICC says the tournament set viewing and attendance records. It drew 245,815 spectators across 25 matchdays, more than 100,000 above the previous record. The Lord's final drew 28,887, the largest women's cricket crowd in the UK. This is a clear sign of commercial and audience growth in women's sport.

sports.headline: NBA heads to Mexico City as Adam Silver touts the city as a future expansion location
sports.summary: The NBA plays its fifth straight regular-season game in Mexico this weekend, the 35th NBA game there. It comes three weeks after Mexico City was floated as an expansion site. Owners were briefed on at least one Mexico City group that approached PJT Partners, the bank leading the expansion process. Silver says an expansion team could be an option 'down the road' but nothing is imminent.

fashion.headline: Martine Rose named Balenciaga creative director, the house's first woman in the role
fashion.summary: Kering confirmed the British-Jamaican designer as Pierpaolo Piccioli's successor, just hours after his departure was announced. She starts on 16 November 2026 and is the first woman to lead the house creatively in its 109-year history. She previously consulted for Demna from 2015 to 2018. Her first collection is expected at Paris Fashion Week in March 2027.

marketing.headline: McDonald's US chief marketing officer Alyssa Buetikofer steps down
marketing.summary: McDonald's told its system on Thursday that its US chief marketing and customer experience officer is leaving. Global CMO Morgan Flatley will serve as interim chief creative officer. Charlie Newberger, a 17-year veteran who led global beverage strategy, becomes interim US chief marketing and commercial officer while the company searches for a replacement.
